name: Dream-Space Convergence
text:
ACTION: Exhaust this card to move 1 nexus token into a system that contains a planet you control. 

When you win a combat as the defender in a system that contains a nexus token, you may exhaust this card to remove your command token from that system and return it to your reinforcements.

name: Will of the Many
text: If you have the Fighter II unit upgrade technology, flip this card and place it on top of Fighter II.

name: From Fire, Resolve
text: ACTION: Exhaust this card to roll 1 of your units' BOMBARDMENT against a planet in an adjacent system. When you do, you may choose to cancel all of those hits to place infantry into coexistence on that planet up to the number of hits produced.

name: Hyperstatic Relays
text: ACTION: Exhaust this card to choose a system that contains 1 or more of your command tokens and your units; resolve those units' PRODUCTION abilities in that system. You may reduce the combined cost of the produced units by the number of your units with PRODUCTION in that system, up to a maximum of 3.

name: Safe Havens
text: Once per action, when you exhaust a planet that has an attachment, you may place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on that planet. When another player commits units to a planet you control, if that planet has an attachment, you may exhaust this card to force your ground forces into coexistence on that planet. That combat ends in a draw.

name: Emotet
text: ACTION: Exhaust this card to allow another player to spend 2 trade goods to research 1 non-faction technology. If they do, you may return that player's control token from your faction sheet to gain that technology and place 1 infantry into coexistence on a non-home planet they control.

name: Tether
text: After another player activates an anomaly that contains your command token and 1 or more of your units, you may exhaust this card to remove your command token from that system. Then, you may remove 1 of your non-fighter ships from another system that contains an anomaly and place it in the active system.

name: Yggdrasil Cannon
text: After 1 or more of your units produces a hit during SPACE CANNON OFFENSE in a system containing your ships: You may cancel 1 of those hits to remove 1 ship from that unit's system and place it into the active system.

name: Ythic Symbiosis
text: Planets you control that have technology specialties cannot be exhausted by other players. When another player commits units onto one of those planets, you may exhaust 1 technology to force those units into coexistence instead.
